quote: One of the best games of this generation, and the best game in the series. A unique RPG where the side quests don't feel like a cheap chore.

author: KaliusMaximus
quote: Probably the worst game in the series. Too much delay on character actions, game feels unresponsive and clunky, combat is the worst in the series by far with unresponsive controls and the story is abysmally bad. Never played such a boring chore in my life and i been gaming for over 30 years. Same copy-pasted fetch quests every time you pledge to a region or you're doing a raid. This game is the definition of money lost in a sewer.

author: KaliusMaximus
quote: Frustrating rogue like game accompanied by boring and repetitive gameplay. You will often lose content due to constant crashing.

author: KaliusMaximus
quote: Best Sony exclusive i've played after Uncharted 4. The game is a great mix of RDR2 set in a zombie (freakers) apocalypse world. Also, it is the longest Sony exclusive game witch starts to really shine after 8-12 hours deep into the story. DG really deserves a sequel because the story ends with a some big cliffhanger witch left the story unfinished and opened to many interpretations.

author: KaliusMaximus
quote: Too much walking based simulation for a pretentious game which should have been fun in the first place. Not good at all.

author: KaliusMaximus
quote: Probably the worst ending in the video games history. Until the end, Ellie doesn't even remember the purpose of herself being a survivor. The true magic and deep human connection from the first game, is long gone.
